The Listing Process

Six steps from decision
to closed.

Every seller I work with goes through the same disciplined process. No shortcuts. No surprises. Just a clear path from where you are to where you want to be.

Step 01
Pricing Strategy

A precise CMA built around your specific property — not the zip code average. I price to attract the right buyer and create competitive tension, not to sit. The goal is multiple offers at above ask, not a price reduction in week three.

Step 02
Property Prep

I walk every property before we list. I tell you exactly what to fix, what to stage, and what buyers will notice before they say a word. You don't spend money guessing — you invest it where it returns.

Step 03
Professional Photography

Every listing gets professional photos. For higher-value properties: aerial drone footage and video walkthroughs. This is what drives online engagement before a single showing is booked — first impression is everything.

Step 04
Marketing Launch

MLS, Zillow Preferred, social campaigns, email to my active buyer database, and targeted digital ads. Your listing doesn't just go live — it gets real exposure to buyers who are actively looking in your price range and market.

Step 05
Offer Management

When offers come in, I walk you through every term — not just the price. Timelines, contingencies, financing strength, escalation clauses. I negotiate the terms that protect your interests all the way through to closing day.

Step 06
Coordinated Closing

Tracy Pavao, our closing coordinator, manages the entire timeline from accepted offer to closing day. You're never chasing documents, wondering what's next, or getting a surprise call the day before closing.

The Marketing Engine

Your listing gets real exposure.

I market properties the way buyers actually find homes in 2026. That means being present everywhere your buyer is looking — not just throwing it on the MLS and hoping.

📱
Zillow Preferred

Your listing featured at the top of Zillow search results for your market. More views, more inquiries, faster timeline. Not every agent has this — I do.

📸
Pro Photography

Professional photographer on every listing. Drone and video available for $500K+ properties. The first impression that converts browsers into buyers.

📣
Social Targeting

Targeted Facebook and Instagram campaigns to buyers actively searching your price point and market. Paid exposure, not organic hope.

📧
Buyer Database

Direct email to active buyer contacts in Follow Up Boss — buyers already looking in your neighborhood who haven't found the right property yet.

🌐
MLS Distribution

Full MLS listing with complete data, maximum photos, and accurate descriptions that convert on every platform that pulls the MLS feed.

🤝
Agent Network

Direct outreach to top-producing agents with active buyers in the market. The off-market introduction before the listing even goes live.

📊
Weekly Reporting

You get a weekly performance report: views, saves, showing requests, and feedback. You always know exactly what's happening with your listing.

🎯
Strategic Pricing

Pricing isn't a guess — it's a strategy. I build a pricing model before we list, not after the market tells us we're wrong.

Questions Sellers Ask

The things people actually want to know.

I build a comparative market analysis specific to your property — not just your zip code. I look at active competition, recent sold data, and days on market trends to find the price that attracts buyers and creates competition, not one that sits. The right price is the one that generates multiple offers within the first two weeks.

It means my sellers, on average, close for 2% above their list price. That's not luck — it's a result of precision pricing, strategic preparation, and competitive offer management. Most sellers accept at or below list. My sellers don't.

As involved or as hands-off as you want. I communicate weekly at minimum, but daily when things are moving. Tracy Pavao handles the administrative side of closing so you're never chasing paperwork. Your job is to be available to make decisions when offers come in.

I'll walk the property and give you an honest assessment of what to fix and what to skip. I have a full vendor directory of trusted contractors who know how to work on a timeline. We can have most properties market-ready within 30 days. I won't recommend spending money where it won't return.

If the property is ready, we can list within a week of our initial conversation. For properties that need prep work, I'll give you a realistic timeline at the walkthrough. I don't rush listings that aren't ready — an underprepared listing leaves money on the table.

Yes — probate and estate sales are one of my specializations. I understand the unique legal and emotional complexity of selling an inherited property and work with preferred attorneys, including Balkun Title, to navigate the process cleanly. If you're dealing with an estate, reach out directly.
